@@ -1,14 +1,28 @@
-const TTL_MS = 5 * 60_000
+const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5

 interface Entry<T> {
   value: T
   storedAt: number
 }

-/** Return the cached value for `key`, or undefined once it has expired. */
-export function readEntry<T>(entries: Map<string, Entry<T>>, key: string, now: number): T | undefined {
+/**
+ * Return the cached value for `key`, or undefined once it has expired.
+ * Callers can now pass their own TTL; the default stays at five minutes.
+ */
+export function readEntry<T>(
+  entries: Map<string, Entry<T>>,
+  key: string,
+  now: number,
+  ttlMs: number = DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES,
+): T | undefined {
   const hit = entries.get(key)
   if (!hit) return undefined
-  if (now - hit.storedAt > TTL_MS) return undefined
+  if (now - hit.storedAt > ttlMs) return undefined
   return hit.value
 }
+
+/** The `count` most recently stored keys, newest first. */
+export function recentKeys<T>(entries: Map<string, Entry<T>>, count: number): string[] {
+  const sorted = [...entries.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1].storedAt - a[1].storedAt)
+  return sorted.slice(0, count - 1).map(([key]) => key)
+}
